utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just worry that one drive can't cover all the heavy repairs we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: True, but even small fixes add up, and we can always do another drive later.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But will we have the momentum to organize another one? These things take a lot of planning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, did you hear about the repair drive happening this weekend at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure did! I've been telling everyone I know. You're coming, right? We need all hands on deck!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely! I wouldn't miss it. I've already gathered a few items to bring—a broken toaster and a shirt with a torn seam.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Jules, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, I'm so excited! I've been talking with Faye about coordinating with the school. Want to join us?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'd love to join! Do I need to bring anything, or will tools be provided?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We're fixing up old bikes and donating them to the kids at the community center. Meet at my garage at 9 AM this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late to this conversation, Vik. 9 AM at your garage on Saturday sounds good—I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Dane! So it's this Saturday at 9 AM at my garage. We'll be fixing up bikes for the kids.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara. I understand now—so it's a community repair event for electronics. Do you need any specific items or volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, it's Saturday 10-2 at the center. Just bring anything busted.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I'll bring my old toaster. Should I also bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira! I'm glad you're here. Are you looking for details about the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The repair drive? You mean the one where they claim to fix things for free? What makes you think that's actually going to work?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I totally get the skepticism! But we've got some really skilled volunteers lined up—several are retired engineers and seamstresses. It's worth a shot, and it's all free!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sam, do you have a definite date for the repair drive yet? I need to know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not sure yet, Eli. I was just talking to Leo about it—maybe ask him?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, I'll talk to Leo. But Sam, can you make sure someone gets back to me with a firm date soon?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's a great idea, Jules! I'll reach out to the school office to see if we can get a sign-up sheet set up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, is that sign-up sheet for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, exactly! I'm hoping to get times that work well with everyone's school schedules.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Opal! The repair drive? I was supposed to check my notes... I think I misplaced them again. Do you know when it is?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm not sure about the exact time, but the map showed the community center parking lot. I'm heading there now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The community center? Right, I remember now! Let me grab my tools — if I can find them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, heard about the repair drive? What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Ira! Yeah, Vik mentioned something about fixing bikes? This Saturday, right? I keep forgetting the details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wait, I thought it was for the community fence? Maybe there are multiple things going on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mara, do you know anyone who might have extra tarps or rope? We're running low.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can ask my neighbor Sam, he's always got extra gear for projects like this.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks Mara, that would be a big help. Let me know when you hear back from Sam.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I heard about the repair drive. I've got a van full of tools if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, bring the van to the fence on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, I'll be there with the van on Saturday. Just point me where to park.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, just reminding you about the repair drive this Saturday—we're fixing bikes for kids at the community center. Meet at my garage at 9 AM!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for the reminder, Vik! I'll meet you at your garage at 9 to help with the bikes, then we'll have the main drive at the center from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, see you at 9 at my garage!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Pia, what's the exact date for the repair drive? I need to add it to my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I believe it's this Saturday, but I'm really worried we won't have enough supplies or people to handle all the problems.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday, you say? Good, that works for me. Let's organize a list of supplies and volunteers so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah... I might not be up for it, but I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries, Uli. It's totally fine if you can't make it. I'll let you know how it goes if you're curious.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Nell. I'll probably just stay home and rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I left my notes somewhere... let me check.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure you even know what you're talking about, Oren? I haven't seen any flyers for this drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I could've sworn I saw a flyer... maybe it was last year's? I'll go hunt for it!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just finished checking the tools. We're ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, can't wait. Should I bring my own stuff too?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No need, we have everything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I was just talking to Faye about coordinating the repair drive with the school schedule—think you could help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, Jules! I'll mention it to folks at the market. What's the school schedule look like?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Faye is checking with the PTA, but I was thinking we could have a sign-up sheet at the school office for times that work best for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, heard you're helping with the repair drive—I've got a van full of tools if you need anything!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's awesome, Gus! We could definitely use those tools—I'll make sure to find you at the event.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds great, I'll have the van packed and ready to go. Just come find me when you need something.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Mina, any chance you know where we can find extra tarps and rope for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Check with Gus—he might have some in his van. What do you need them for?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We need tarps to cover materials in case of rain, and rope for tying things down. Can you ask Gus about it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I just confirmed with Eli, the repair drive is at the community center parking lot. Easy to find!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect! I'm thinking of bringing my old toaster—maybe they can work their magic on it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds like a plan! The parking lot should have plenty of space for small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, fixing up bikes for kids. Sounds good, I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great to have you on board, Noah! The kids are gonna love those repaired bikes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it. I'll try to remember to bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, just let me know when.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'll check the school calendar and let you know what times work best.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, just send me the times and I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might have some rope in my garage. I'll check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, rope? Is that for the repair drive too? What would we use it for?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, for the repair drive—maybe to tie up loose fence posts or secure tarps.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
